summary: The analyzed candidates predominantly exhibit dual roles as confounders and effect modifiers. Radiographic features (pleural effusion, pneumonia, posterior fossa findings, tumor location/morphology/size) and therapy history (radiation, platinum chemo, treatment regimen) all show consistent support for predicting both treatment and outcome, alongside credible evidence for treatment-effect modification from causal forests and R-learners.
